capabilities: draw glowing trails that fade or persist over the interface
switch between freehand, rectangle, straight line, and eraser tools
customize color, width, and opacity via a floating toolbar and settings
save and restore drawings across laser sessions
auto-switch the note to reading mode while the laser is active
extras: Installation requires manually copying release files into the plugins folder; no community-plugin store install is described.
problem: When sharing a screen or presenting notes, the native mouse cursor is hard for viewers to follow and there is no way to highlight, underline, or circle content live.
summary: Screen annotation tool that draws a glowing laser dot and fading or persistent trails over the vault for presentations and calls.
